fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-05-29, an unidentified customer allegedly took grocery stock worth Rs. 25,000 from Nila Electronics near Senthil Garden Main Street. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-05-29 at roughly 12:35. Contact details given by the complainant, Dharani Anand, include the number 9000000114. The complainant is associated with the business Nila Electronics. The complaint mentions Rajesh Chandran, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000486, in connection with the events. The complaint refers to Ajith Murugan, a driver, reachable on 9000000225. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as a customer and took items while staff were attending to others.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, associate, afternoon, suspect, main street, mobile number
